content.value_statement: CloudBase teams need repeatable command-line workflows for deployments and resource changes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through tcb CLI tasks.
actual_capabilities: Guides CloudBase CLI login, environment switching, help checks, and error diagnosis.
Routes tasks to focused references for functions, apps, CloudRun, hosting, storage, databases, permissions, and access settings.
Provides deployment and verification workflows for CloudBase services.
Documents safe handling of environment variables, secrets, and CI/CD credentials.
Covers destructive operations with dry-run, confirmation, and post-change verification steps.
Helps troubleshoot tcb command failures using exit codes, logs, and official docs lookup.
limitations: Requires the tcb CLI to be installed, authenticated, and allowed to access the target CloudBase environment.
Does not replace Tencent Cloud console workflows or CloudBase MCP tool calls.
Commands can modify cloud resources, so users must confirm environment IDs and destructive actions.
CLI syntax can change, so unfamiliar commands should be checked with help before use.

use_cases.title: Deploy Cloud Functions
use_cases.description: Prepare, deploy, and verify CloudBase cloud functions from a terminal workflow.

use_cases.title: Operate CloudRun Services
use_cases.description: Deploy services, inspect traffic, manage secrets, and review logs for CloudRun workloads.

use_cases.title: Manage Access and Data Resources
use_cases.description: Update storage, hosting, database, permission, CORS, domain, and routing settings with safer checks.

prompt_templates.title: Check My CloudBase Environment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the CloudBase CLI skill to check my login status, confirm the active environment, and list the safety checks before any change.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy One Cloud Function
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the CloudBase CLI skill to deploy one cloud function named my-function, verify the result, and explain each command before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Configure CloudRun Secrets
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the CloudBase CLI skill to plan CloudRun secret updates for my service, preserve existing values, and verify the updated configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Build a CI/CD Release Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the CloudBase CLI skill to design a CI/CD workflow for dev, staging, and production with dry-run, rollback, and verification gates.

output_examples.input: Deploy a React app to a confirmed CloudBase environment.
output: Confirms the target environment before deployment.
Checks the app deployment command syntax first.
Runs the deployment only after the user approves the target.
Verifies the created app version and reports the result.

output_examples.input: Add a temporary contractor to a limited role.
output: Lists the current role and confirms the intended user.
Applies the limited role update with explicit approval.
Verifies membership and records the removal step.
Checks command output, exit status, and service details.
Reviews recent logs for the affected service.
Suggests a focused recovery step instead of repeated retries.

best_practices: Confirm the target environment ID before every deployment or resource change.
Use help output for unfamiliar commands before running them.
Run dry-run or verification steps whenever the referenced workflow supports them.
anti_patterns: Do not run destructive commands with automatic confirmation before the user approves the exact target.
Do not hardcode API keys, database URLs, or session tokens in files or prompts.
Do not retry failing cloud commands repeatedly without reading the error and checking the active environment.

faq.question: What does this skill help manage?
faq.answer: It helps manage CloudBase resources through documented tcb CLI workflows.

faq.question: Does it require CloudBase credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. The local tcb CLI must be authenticated for the target environment.

faq.question: Can it deploy production resources?
faq.answer: Yes, if the authenticated user has access. Confirm the environment and action before deployment.

faq.question: Does it expose secrets?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The references recommend environment variables and secret storage instead of hardcoded credentials.

faq.question: Can it replace the CloudBase console?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on terminal workflows and does not cover every console-only operation.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
